body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2024-07-30 (Q1FY25 concall transcript): "we will have a capacity of 300,000 tonnes, which we are expanding by 25% to increase by 75,000 tonnes" Metric: Installed tower/pole capacity. Target: 375,000 MTPA; +INR 800-1,000 cr revenue potential. Deadline: FY25 capex year (date given later as Mar-2025). Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: partly. Evidence: +75k t was 'fully installed and commercially operational' by the Q1FY26 call (31-Jul-2025). Cost ~INR 200 cr as promised. Revenue potential was cut to INR 700 cr (Feb-25), then restored to ~INR 1,000 cr (Jul-25). Delivered about one quarter late against the Mar-2025 date given in Oct-24. Explanation given: none given; 'part ... spill over' (Feb-25, prompted)
